summary: StudentDocument manages student-uploaded documents (resumes, photos, other types) within the HSPnet system. It encapsulates document metadata, supports workflows for adding, searching, deleting, and withholding documents, and enforces business rules for anonymity, visibility, and document type classification.
purpose: To store, retrieve, and control access to student-related documents, enforce business rules around document types, maintain privacy/anonymity, and structure document management for use in student applications, staff review, and internal processes.

workflows.name: Add Student Document
steps: Validate TypeCodeID (must not be 0; else return error)
Determine document type (Anonymous, Named, Photo) via code lookup
Set anonymity and document name fields accordingly
Insert document record via StudentDocumentAddDoc stored procedure

workflows.name: Search Documents by StudentID
steps: Call StudentDocumentSearch stored procedure with StudentID and access flags
Filter returned documents based on anonymity and type codes
Fill list of StudentDocument objects with metadata
Remove photo uploads if privacy conditions dictate

workflows.name: Delete Student Document
steps: Remove file and containing folder from disk (ignore filesystem exceptions)

workflows.name: Withhold Student Document
steps: Retrieve withheld documents by program ID

workflows.name: Select Documents for Employment Application
steps: Use GetSelectableByStudentID to retrieve eligible documents
Apply business logic to filter based on document types (anon, named, photo)

workflows.name: Retrieve Student Photo Document
steps: Populate StudentDocument with photo file path and URL

business_rules: Anonymity is set based on TypeCodeID (RESUME-ANON, RESUME-NAMED, PHOTO).
For anonymous mode and student-uploaded documents, personal info (names, agency) is cleared.
Only certain document types may be displayed in anonymous mode.
Agency and user formatting rules for display.
Email display only allowed if document is not uploaded by student.
Documents can be flagged as Withhold to restrict access.
validations: File existence checked before building download URL.
UpdateDate must not be null for displaying updated details.
Email presence and upload status checked before formatting email.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted builds short display name from initials.
UpdatedDetails concatenates updated metadata for display.
conditions: If anonymity mode is enabled and document was uploaded by student, personal info is hidden.
If type code is 'OTHER', display as 'Other' regardless of underlying code.
If user is staff and staffID matches studentID, anonymous documents are removed from list.
If email is blank or document uploaded by student, do not display formatted email.
Photos are hidden based on privacy and launch context.
system_behavior: Supports CRUD operations (add, delete, search) via stored procedures.
Handles exception for filesystem operations without interrupting workflow.
Uses localization and alt-language fields for display where required.
Allows unlimited document uploads for employment applications.
dependencies: Relies on stored procedures: StudentDocumentAddDoc, StudentDocumentSearch, StudentDocumentDelete, StudentDocumentUpdateInfo, GetStudentDocumentWithhold, StudentPhotoSearch, StudentDocumentSearchByID.
Depends on Codes lookup for document types.
UI.Localization and UI.NameFormatter for display formatting.
exceptions: Administrative setup errors if document type codes are missing.
File deletion or folder removal failures are ignored.
Database read errors and procedure failures not explicitly handled in document logic.
content_gaps: Details of stored procedure implementations (business logic in DB) are not included.
No specifics on document type code values beyond RESUME-ANON, RESUME-NAMED, PHOTO.
No explicit error handling for DB operation failures.
No UI layer or API contract documented.
